clusters.mechanism: Runner redacts credentials without first stripping terminal/ANSI formatting, so a formatted credential isn't matched and the tail cut then discards its prefix, leaving an unredacted suffix.
Multiline credentials containing terminal formatting escape both the streaming redaction and the per-line excerpt redaction in failure excerpts, so they reach results and persistence.
Replacing complete matches before retaining the chunk overlap destroys the prefix of a longer overlapping credential, leaking its suffix across chunks.
The privacy filter withholds any string containing the literal "[redacted]", hiding whole fields (MCP, digest, status) rather than just the secret.

Unrequested scope creep: redactGateData is applied via JSON round-trip to every HTTP/SSE response, run state, prompts and reports, rewriting unrelated objects (adding confinementError) and adding cost.
Artifact endpoint re-parses and compactly re-serializes JSON artifacts and VT-strips text artifacts, so served bytes differ from stored ones.
Prompt builders pass whole inputs including the patch under review through VT stripping/redaction, so the reviewer sees a different diff than what will merge.
New stdoutTruncated/stderrTruncated fields on ProcResult are added but never used in src.
confinementError is always written and output VT-stripped, so an older release reading the new rows misclassifies results on rollback.
